# Good Example

> Good Example is a tiny fixture site used to test the seo-audit tool. It sells a made-up service and must never be deployed.

This file is intentionally short. It links two real pages in the fixture build and a language version.

## Services

- [Example service](https://good.example/services/example/): A valid example service page.

- [English](https://good.example/)
- [Français](https://good.example/fr/)
